in_english.name: Lazzat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lazzat is derived from the Arabic root 'l-z-z', which means pleasure, delight, enjoyment, sweetness, and happiness. It is also a name from the Quran and is one of the names of Allah. In Islamic tradition, Lazzat is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's (s.a.w.) characteristics and is a name that conveys a sense of pleasure, delight, and happiness. It is also a name that symbolizes the attainment of one's desires and the pursuit of happiness. In Islamic culture, Lazzat is considered a blessed name and is often given to children as a means of invoking Allah's blessings and guidance.
